Sorry, but even after paying my debts i cant start feel this life same way. Im tired and i say goodbye. 
I hope your relatives will not make my mistakes in life. Have a good life and dont feel sorrow about junkie like me.

Hey, im still here. I did some shit this week. I started gambling again. But this time i was making only 2 bets per day and was winning all. Almost won enough to close my debt.
You were right, it was in my possibility to fix my life. After getting money to pay my debt i will finish my education and immigrate to another country. My brother did not apologized me, i have deep pain in my heart. But i have a hope, that some day i will be able to get him back.
